title: Set the laptop up for the evening
drDigitalIntro:
It is late, the room is dark, and the screen is too bright to look at.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

playgroundTask.goal: You set the screen up for a dark room
playgroundTask.hint: Two different pages of Settings are involved. One controls how bright the screen is; another controls whether it is light or dark.

steps.say: The screen is showing light text on a dark background.
The screen is dimmer than it was.
The colours are warmer, for looking at late at night.

drDigitalSuccess: Dark, dim, warm and quiet. That is a laptop you can use at midnight without regretting it.
drDigitalHint: Work through the list on the left. Appearance holds the light-or-dark switch, Display holds brightness, and the quiet switch is under Notifications.
